scripts.dev: sh -c 'npm run db:push && PORT="${API_PORT:-4173}" tsx watch src/server/index.ts'
scripts.db:push: sh -c 'mkdir -p data; export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-file:../data/homelab.db}" RUST_LOG=info; prisma db push --skip-generate && prisma generate'
scripts.build: npm run clean && prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && vite build
scripts.test: sh -c 'test_dir="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/homelab-dashboard-test.XXXXXX")" || exit 1; cleanup() { rm -rf "$test_dir"; }; trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM; export NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL="file:$test_dir/test.db" ADMIN_PASSWORD=test-pass COOKIE_SECRET=test-cookie-secret-with-more-than-32-chars RUST_LOG=info; prisma generate && prisma db push --skip-generate && vitest run'
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.validate: npm run licenses:check && npm run check:stale-files && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && playwright test && npm run audit:production && npm run audit:all
